purpose: Stage best for deterministic/static replay gates that need retained color-contour ownership and cached stereo rough distance without per-frame color/stereo cost.
expected_effect: Retain full-frame cluster assignment through FarBackground fallback.
Keep low-frequency cached ApproxStereoContour rough-distance evidence for static replay cases.
Avoid running heavy color contour extraction and stereo matching on every scored replay frame.
applicability: low-motion scenes where cached color contours remain aligned
risk: Cached contours can lag during camera motion, object motion, hand occlusion, or reappearance.
Motion-sensitive replay cases must pass before this can be promoted beyond the static replay bucket.
